summary: Brookfield Finance Inc., guaranteed by Brookfield Corporation, priced a US$600 million SEC-registered offering of 5.650% senior unsecured notes due September 23, 2031, per a final Canadian term sheet dated September 21, 2026 filed under Form 6-K. Notes priced at 99.966% of par for a 5.658% yield, T+2 settlement September 23, 2026, semi-annual coupons each March 23 and September 23 from March 23, 2027. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine investment-grade shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch spread-to-Treasury and curve dynamics.
